ingredients: 1 pound ground chicken | 2/3 cup Italian-flavored bread crumbs | 1/2 cup shredded carrots (optional) | 1/2 cup shredded Parmesan | 1 egg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with foil, coat with nonstick spray. Mix all ingredients together with clean hands. Roll into 2-tablespoon-size meatballs and place on baking sheet. Bake for 24–26 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.

ingredients: 1 whole wheat flour tortilla (fajita size) | 1–2 tablespoons mayo (or mustard, hummus, guacamole, or butter) | 2 slices turkey lunch meat | 1–2 slices cheese | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Place tortilla on a cutting board; warm 15 seconds in microwave if cold. Spread mayo to 1/4 inch from edges. Add cheese and turkey on one side, veggies in the middle. Roll tightly and cut in half or into spirals with a serrated knife.

ingredients: 1½ cups milk | 1 cup grated carrot | 1 cup shredded mozzarella | 1/4 cup grated Parmesan | 1/4 cup melted butter or oil | 1/4 cup diced pepperoni plus 2 tablespoons (optional) | 2 eggs | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2½ teaspoons pizza seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; grease a standard 12-cup muffin tin. Mix milk, carrot, cheeses, butter, pepperoni, and eggs in a bowl. Stir in flours, baking powder, baking soda, pizza seasoning, and salt. Divide batter into muffin tin (heaping 1/4 cup each). Top each with reserved pepperoni. Bake 18–20 minutes until golden and a tester comes out clean. Cool 2–5 minutes before removing.

recipe_name: Easy Hummus Wrap (to Share with the Kids)
ingredients: 1 whole wheat flour tortilla (fajita size) | 1/4 cup hummus | 1–2 slices cheese | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce | 1/4 cup thinly sliced bell pepper | 1/4 cup thinly sliced cucumber
instructions: Place wrap on cutting board; warm 15 seconds in microwave if needed. Spread hummus to 1/2 inch from edges. Add cheese and veggies in a line down the middle. Roll as tightly as possible. Cut in half with a serrated knife and serve.

recipe_name: Veggie Grilled Cheese Sandwich (to Share with the Kids)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 2 slices sourdough or whole grain bread | 2 slices cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons mashed sweet potato
instructions: Add butter to a nonstick pan over medium heat. Spread sweet potato onto one bread slice; place cheese on the other. Place both bread slices toppings-side-up in the pan; swirl to coat with butter. Cook 3 minutes. Press the two halves together; cook 3–4 more minutes, flipping until both sides are golden. Cut into halves, sticks, or dice.

ingredients: 8 slices soft whole grain bread | About 1–2 tablespoons filling per sandwich (PB&J, sunflower seed butter and jam, cream cheese and jam, or turkey and cheese) | Sandwich sealer or fork
instructions: Warm bread 5–10 seconds in microwave. With sealer: stack 2 slices, press outer round to cut circles, add filling, seal with inner press. With fork: cut rounds with cookie cutter, add thin layer of filling, crimp edges firmly with a fork. Serve immediately or freeze in a bag for up to 3 months.

ingredients: 1 pound pasta | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 cups diced cucumbers | 2 cups halved cherry tomatoes | 14.5-ounce can white cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2–3/4 cup pesto | Salt to taste
instructions: Cook pasta per package directions; drain into a large bowl. Toss with olive oil and let cool slightly. Stir in cucumbers, tomatoes, beans, and pesto (start with 1/2 cup and add more to taste). Season with salt. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate up to 3 days.

ingredients: TURKEY-CHEESE: 1 whole wheat tortilla | 1 oz deli turkey | 1 oz sliced cheese | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce | 2 tablespoons mayo or mustard || STRAWBERRY-NUTELLA: 1 whole wheat tortilla | 2 tablespoons Nutella | 1/2 cup thinly sliced strawberries || HUMMUS-VEGGIE: 1 whole wheat tortilla | 1/4 cup hummus | 1/4 cup matchstick cucumber
instructions: Place tortilla on cutting board; warm 5–10 seconds in microwave if needed. Spread condiment, nut butter, or hummus. Top with fillings. Roll up tightly from one side. Cut into rounds or halves with a serrated knife.

recipe_name: Quick Sandwich Roll Ups (2-Minute School Lunch)
ingredients: 1–2 slices soft sandwich bread | 1 tablespoon peanut butter (or sunflower seed butter, almond butter, cream cheese, or Nutella) | 1 tablespoon jam, jelly, chia jam, or apple butter
instructions: Warm bread 5–10 seconds in microwave. Place on cutting board and roll flat with a rolling pin. Spread filling to the edges. Roll up from one long side, keeping it tight. Slice with a serrated knife into ~1-inch rounds. Serve or pack in lunchbox.

ingredients: 3 cups strawberries, stems removed | 1 tablespoon honey or agave (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 225°F. Blend strawberries until smooth; add honey if needed. Pour onto a Silpat-lined baking sheet and spread into a smooth, even layer. Bake 2–3 hours until dry and no longer sticky. Cool at room temperature at least 2 hours (overnight is best). Peel off mat, place on parchment, cut into strips, and roll up.

ingredients: 2 pieces sandwich bread | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | Maple syrup or honey for dipping
instructions: Cut crusts off bread in one long piece. Wind each slice into a pinwheel and secure with a toothpick. Melt butter in a sauté pan over medium heat; sprinkle cinnamon in the pan. Add pinwheels and cook 2 minutes per side until golden. Serve with maple syrup or honey.

ingredients: 2 spinach wraps | 2 tablespoons pesto | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup mozzarella, shredded or chopped
instructions: Lay spinach wrap on flat surface. Spread 1 tablespoon pesto over wrap. Sprinkle 1/4 cup chopped tomatoes and 1/4 cup mozzarella over wrap. Roll up like a burrito and slice into coins. Repeat with second wrap.

ingredients: 1 cup nut or seed butter (almond, peanut, or sunflower) | 5 dates, pitted | 1/4 cup protein powder | 3/4 cup hemp seeds | 1/4 cup chia seeds
instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor and blend until combined. Roll into balls using 1 tablespoon of mixture per ball. Optional: Drizzle with melted dark chocolate mixed with coconut oil.

ingredients: 15.5-ounce can garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 6 ounces roasted red bell peppers (about 1 pepper) | 1 garlic clove | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor. Pulse until completely smooth. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed. Serve with pita, veggies, or crackers. Store in fridge up to 5 days.

ingredients: 4 slices sandwich bread | 4 mozzarella string cheese sticks (or 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella) | 4 pepperoni, diced (optional) | 1/2 cup marinara sauce, warmed | 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Cut crusts off bread. Roll each slice flat with a rolling pin. Place a cheese stick at one edge; add pepperoni if using. Roll up tightly pressing the seam down. Heat butter in sauté pan over medium heat; cook roll ups seam-side down 1–2 minutes until golden. Continue turning until golden all over. Cut each into 4 pieces if desired; serve with marinara.

ingredients: 6 mozzarella string cheese sticks | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 large eggs | 1 cup breadcrumbs or panko | 1 teaspoon Italian herbs | 1 teaspoon salt | Olive oil or cooking spray | Marinara sauce for dipping
instructions: Cut each cheese stick into 4 pieces (24 total). Set up assembly line: flour in one bowl, whisked eggs with 2 teaspoons water in second bowl, breadcrumbs mixed with herbs and salt in third. Coat each cheese cube in flour, then egg, then breadcrumb mixture. Place in air fryer basket; coat with cooking spray. Air fry at 350°F for 8–10 minutes until golden. Serve with dipping sauce.

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1 large egg | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 cup fresh spinach, packed | 1/3 cup sugar | 3 tablespoons olive, avocado, or canola oil | 1½ cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place applesauce, egg, vanilla, spinach, sugar, and oil in a food processor and puree. Combine dry ingredients in a separate bowl. Pour spinach puree into a large mixing bowl. Slowly mix dry ingredients into wet until combined. Scoop batter into a greased muffin tin, filling each cup 2/3 full. Bake 18–20 minutes for regular or 12 minutes for mini muffins.

ingredients: 1 cup packed fresh spinach | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 large egg | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Blend spinach, buttermilk, egg, and oil until smooth. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Whisk wet ingredients into dry until just combined — do not overmix. Heat pan over medium heat and grease with butter or oil. Pour about 1 tablespoon batter per silver-dollar pancake. Cook 2 minutes, flip, cook 1 minute more. Serve warm.

ingredients: 1/4 cup organic popcorn kernels | 1 brown paper lunch bag | Salt, butter, or toppings of choice
instructions: Place popcorn kernels in the paper bag. Fold down the top of the bag twice (no staples or tape). Microwave on high for 1.5–2 minutes, keeping an eye on it. Stop when popping slows to 2–3 seconds between pops. Pour into a bowl and sprinkle with salt, butter, or favorite toppings.

ingredients: 1/2 pound sharp cheddar cheese, grated (about 2 cups) | 5 tablespoons chilled butter, cut into cubes | 1 cup all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting | Raw pecan halves (optional)
instructions: Add cheese, flour, and butter to a food processor and combine (dough may be crumbly but will hold). Shape dough into a thick flat circle on parchment, cover, and refrigerate 1 hour or overnight. Preheat oven to 400°F. Roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into shapes with cookie cutters. Place on lined baking sheet; add pecan halves if desired. Bake 12–15 minutes. Cool 2 minutes before removing.

ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup pure maple syrup, honey, or agave | 2 large eggs | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup cashew or almond butter | 1/4 cup unsweetened plant-based milk | 2¼ cups rolled oats | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1¼ cups chocolate chips, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F; grease a 12-cup muffin tin or line with paper cups. Place all ingredients except chocolate chips in a blender, starting with wet ingredients. Blend 10 seconds until oats begin to break down. Add 1 cup chocolate chips and blend 10 more seconds. Divide batter into muffin cups, filling 3/4 full. Top with remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips. Bake 20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

ingredients: 3/4 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup honey | 3½ cups O's cereal | 3 tablespoons hemp seeds | 2 tablespoons chia seeds
instructions: Melt peanut butter and honey together in a saucepan over low heat, stirring 1 minute, or microwave in 30-second increments until combined. In a bowl, stir together cereal, hemp seeds, and chia seeds. Pour peanut butter mixture over cereal and stir to coat evenly. Press mixture firmly into a greased, parchment-lined 8x8-inch pan until smooth and flat. Refrigerate or freeze 15 minutes. Cut into bars.

recipe_name: Watermelon Fries with Honey Lime Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 seedless watermelon | Tajín (optional) || FOR DIP: 1 cup Greek yogurt | Juice of 1 lime | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Cut watermelon in half then into 1-inch half moons. Remove the rind and cut into 3-inch sticks. Sprinkle with Tajín if desired. For dip: mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, and honey until combined. Serve watermelon fries alongside dip.

recipe_name: Crispy Green Bean Fries with Honey Mustard Dip
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat panko or breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 large eggs | 1/4 cup flour | 1 pound fresh green beans, cut into 2–3-inch pieces | Cooking oil spray || FOR DIP: 1/4 cup mustard (yellow or Dijon) | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Mix panko, salt, and garlic powder in a bowl. Whisk eggs in second bowl. Place flour in third bowl. Dip green beans in flour, then egg, then breadcrumb mixture. AIR FRYER: Air fry at 400°F for 6–8 minutes until golden. OVEN: Preheat to 450°F. Arrange coated beans on a greased baking sheet, spray with oil, bake 15 minutes until golden. Mix mustard and honey for dipping sauce. Serve immediately.

ingredients: 1 cup sliced ripe banana (about 2 small) | 2 cups lightly packed baby spinach | 3/4 cup milk | 1/4 cup honey | 2 tablespoons melted butter or neutral oil | 2 eggs | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 cup rolled oats | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1 cup whole-wheat flour | Mini chocolate chips (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; grease a standard muffin tin. Place all ingredients except flour and chocolate chips in a blender and blend until very smooth — batter should be green like a smoothie. Pulse in flour just to combine. Pour batter into muffin tin, filling each cup about 3/4 full. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top if using. Bake 18–20 minutes until firm to touch and lightly browned around edges. Cool on a wire rack.

recipe_name: Frozen Chocolate Peanut Butter Banana Bites
ingredients: 2 bananas, sliced into about 30 wheels | 5 tablespoons peanut butter (or almond, cashew, or sunflower butter) | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 cup semi-sweet, dark, or milk chocolate chips
instructions: Place 15 banana slices on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Top each with 1/2 teaspoon peanut butter. Top with another banana slice to make sandwiches. Freeze for 1 hour. Melt coconut oil and chocolate chips together until smooth; cool 5 minutes. Using a fork, dip frozen banana sandwiches in chocolate until coated. Return to parchment and freeze 1 more hour. Store in freezer bags up to 3 months.

ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup whole wheat flour | 3/4 cup old-fashioned oats | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1 large egg, whisked | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 3/4 cup milk | 1/3 cup vegetable or canola oil | 2 cups frozen berries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Combine flours, oats, baking powder, salt, and brown sugar in a bowl. In a separate bowl, combine egg, vanilla, milk, and oil. Slowly stir dry ingredients into wet ingredients. Gently fold in frozen berries (don't thaw first) — don't overmix. Pour batter into greased or lined muffin tins. Bake 20–22 minutes. Cool 5 minutes then remove to a rack.

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened | 1/2 cup granulated sugar | 1 large egg | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 cup fresh blueberries | Powdered sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt; set aside. Cream butter and sugar with a mixer. Add egg, buttermilk, and vanilla; combine. Add flour mixture and mix until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries. Spoon into greased and floured doughnut pan, filling 3/4 full. Bake 14 minutes until tops spring back when pressed. Cool and dust with powdered sugar.

ingredients: 1 pound vegetables of choice, cut into equal sizes | 3 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 cup water | 4 garlic cloves, thinly sliced | 6 sprigs dill | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Divide the vegetables between 2 16-ounce mason jars. Combine salt, sugar, vinegar, and water in a saucepan over low heat; whisk until salt and sugar dissolve. Divide garlic, dill, and bay leaves between the jars. Pour vinegar mixture over vegetables and cover jars. Refrigerate for 2–3 days before enjoying. Keeps up to 2–3 weeks refrigerated.

ingredients: 1/2 baguette, sliced into 1/2-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, plus more for bread | 2½ cups cored, seeded, and diced tomatoes | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced fresh basil | 1/4 teaspoon minced garlic | 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. In a bowl, combine tomatoes, 3 tablespoons olive oil, basil, garlic, and salt; stir and let marinate. Brush bread slices lightly with olive oil and place on a lined baking sheet. Bake 4–7 minutes until golden. Let bread cool completely. Top cooled bread slices with tomato mixture and serve.

ingredients: 1/2 baguette, sliced into 1/2-inch pieces | Oil or cooking spray | 2 ripe peaches, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | Honey to taste | Fresh basil for garnish (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Lightly brush or spray baguette slices with oil. Bake on a baking sheet 3–5 minutes until golden. Allow bread to cool completely. Spread each piece with 2 tablespoons ricotta, top with 2 tablespoons chopped peaches, and drizzle with honey. Garnish with fresh basil if desired.

ingredients: 25 ounces canned chicken (two 12.5-ounce cans) | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard | 1/4 cup minced red onion | 1/4 cup minced fresh parsley | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Drain the chicken. Add to a medium bowl with cranberries, mayo, mustard, red onion, parsley, and pepper. Stir well, breaking up any chicken chunks. Serve with crackers, over lettuce, or in a sandwich. Store in an airtight container in the fridge up to 5 days.

ingredients: 1 pound pasta (small shapes preferred) | 2 cups frozen petite peas | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup heavy cream or half-and-half (optional) | Salt, pepper, lemon zest, fresh basil (optional)
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil; cook pasta per package directions. Place peas in a colander in the sink. When pasta is done, drain directly over the peas. Return pasta and peas to the pot. Stir in butter, Parmesan, and cream if using. Season with optional toppings. Serve warm.

ingredients: 1 mini naan flatbread | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 4–6 slices pepperoni | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce | Milk and fruit (optional sides)
instructions: Place naan, mozzarella, pepperoni, and pizza sauce in a lunchbox. Use a small dip container for the pizza sauce to prevent spills. Kids can assemble their own little pizza or dip the bread in the sauce and eat everything separately. Serve cold or warm the bread first if preferred.

ingredients: 1/2 cup crackers (or mini naan or pita bread) | 1/4 cup cheese (cheddar, mozzarella, or Colby Jack) | 1–2 ounces deli meat (turkey, ham, pepperoni, or salami) | 1/2 cup produce (cucumbers, carrots, strawberries, or other fruit) | Dip, sauce, or dessert (optional)
instructions: Place all ingredients into a lunch box compartments. Use a small dip container for any sauces to prevent spills. Seal the lunchbox. Kids can stack the ingredients to make little sandwiches or eat them separately. Make up to 48 hours ahead and refrigerate.

ingredients: 4 slices soft sandwich bread per flavor || PB&J: 1/4 cup peanut butter + 1/4 cup jelly || NUTELLA-RASPBERRY: 1/4 cup Nutella + 1 cup lightly mashed raspberries || GOAT CHEESE-CUCUMBER: 1/4 cup herbed goat cheese + 1 cup thinly sliced cucumber || CREAM CHEESE-CUCUMBER: 1/4 cup cream cheese + 1 cup thinly sliced cucumber || HUMMUS-CARROT: 1/4 cup hummus + 1/2 cup shredded carrot || EGG-BUTTER: 1/4 cup unsalted butter + 2 hard-cooked eggs, sliced
instructions: Place bread on a cutting board. Use a 3–4-inch round cookie cutter to cut circles from each slice. Add a thin layer of spread to one bread round. Add a thin layer of filling on top. For PB&J, add jelly to the second piece. Press rounds together. Serve immediately or refrigerate in an airtight container up to 24 hours.

ingredients: 1 pound ground turkey | 1/2 cup Italian-flavored breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup shredded sweet potato | 1/2 cup shredded or grated Parmesan | 1 egg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and coat with nonstick spray. Mix all ingredients together with clean hands. Roll into 1-tablespoon-size balls and place on the baking sheet. Bake 18–20 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm with marinara or store/freeze.

recipe_name: Mini Egg Muffins with Cheese and Veggies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon onion, peeled and grated (or 1/4 teaspoon onion powder) | 1/2 cup butternut squash, finely grated (or minced broccoli, grated carrot, or minced spinach) | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup cottage cheese, drained if needed | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons grated Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F; grease 12 mini muffin cups very well with nonstick spray. Stir all ingredients together in a medium bowl. Spoon into muffin cups, filling nearly to the brim. Bake 18–20 minutes until firm to the touch and golden around the edges. Cool 5 minutes before removing from pan.

ingredients: 14.5-ounce can wild Alaskan salmon, drained | 1/4 cup plain whole milk Greek yogurt (or mayonnaise) | 2 tablespoons relish | 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon dried parsley | Bread, crackers, or cucumbers for serving
instructions: Drain the salmon. Add all ingredients to a bowl. Mix well with a fork, mashing thoroughly to crush the soft bones and combine flavors. Serve on toast, with crackers, or as a dip with sliced cucumbers. Store in an airtight container in the fridge up to 5 days.

ingredients: 1 pound ground chicken | 1/2 cup shredded zucchini, squeezed very dry | 1/2 cup Italian-flavored breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup shredded Parmesan | 1/4 cup pesto | 1 egg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and coat with nonstick spray. Mix all ingredients together with clean hands. Roll into tablespoon-size balls and place on baking sheet. Bake 22–24 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. (Air fryer: 12 minutes at 375°F.) Serve with marinara or pesto sauce.

ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 cup milk | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1/3 cup canola oil (or melted butter)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; grease a 24-cup mini muffin tin. Stir all ingredients together in a medium bowl until combined. Portion 1½ tablespoons batter into each cup. Bake 8–10 minutes until edges are lightly golden and a tester inserted in the center comes out clean. Transfer to a wire rack to cool. Serve warm or at room temperature.

ingredients: 1/2 cup applesauce | 1/2 cup milk | 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted and cooled | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1¼ cups all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup rolled oats | 1/3 cup sugar | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 cup blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; grease a 12-cup muffin pan (skip paper liners). Whisk applesauce, milk, butter, eggs, and vanilla in a medium bowl. Add flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; whisk into a thick batter. Gently stir in blueberries. Divide batter among muffin cups (about 1/4 cup each). Bake 14–16 minutes until golden and a tester comes out clean. Cool briefly then transfer to a wire rack.

ingredients: 1½ cups rolled oats | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted | 1/3 cup sugar (or honey) | 1/4 cup milk | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup natural raspberry preserves | 1 cup halved raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F; line an 8x8-inch pan with parchment paper, leaving overhang. Mix oats, flour, sugar, butter, milk, vanilla, and salt in a bowl into a thick uniform dough. Reserve 1 cup for topping. Press remaining dough into the pan. Spread preserves evenly over dough, then sprinkle raspberries on top. Crumble reserved dough over top; press lightly. Bake 35–40 minutes until lightly browned. Cool completely, lift out with parchment, and slice with a serrated knife.

ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower florets | 1 cup fully cooked quinoa, slightly cooled | 1/3 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons plain or seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons shredded Parmesan | 1 egg | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon pizza seasoning or cumin (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; line a baking sheet with parchment. Boil water and pour over cauliflower in a bowl; soak 5 minutes. Drain and pat very dry with a towel. Place cauliflower, quinoa, cheeses, egg, breadcrumbs, flour, salt, and spices in a food processor. Process into a uniform batter. Scoop 1-tablespoon balls onto baking sheet. Bake 22–24 minutes until lightly golden. Serve with ketchup. (Air fryer: 12 minutes at 375°F.)

ingredients: 1½ cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 cup mashed very ripe banana (about 2 medium) | 1/4 cup plain whole-milk Greek yogurt | 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted and cooled | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; grease a 12-cup muffin pan. In a medium bowl, stir together banana, yogurt, butter, eggs, and vanilla. Add flour, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; gently stir into a thick batter. Divide batter among muffin cups (heaping 1/4 cup each). Bake 14–16 minutes until edges are lightly golden and a tester comes out clean. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

ingredients: 1 cup whole-milk cottage cheese | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted and cooled | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 1½ cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 cup blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; grease a 12-cup muffin pan. Blend cottage cheese smooth in a blender. Combine with maple syrup, butter, eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl; whisk together. In another bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon. Gently stir cottage cheese mixture into flour mixture (batter will be thick). Fold in blueberries. Divide batter among muffin cups (about 1/4 cup each). Bake 16–18 minutes until edges are golden and a tester comes out clean. Transfer to a wire rack.

recipe_name: Baked Apples with Cinnamon and Raisins
ingredients: 2 apples, cored | 2–3 teaspoons raisins | 2 tablespoons water | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place cored apples in a small baking dish. Fill the center of each apple with raisins. Stir water, cinnamon, and apple juice together in a small bowl; pour evenly into the centers of each apple. Bake about 55 minutes until apples are fork-tender. Let cool slightly, remove skins if desired, and serve warm.

ingredients: 1 large apple, peeled, cored, and diced (about 1 cup) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 3 tablespoons light or dark brown sugar | 1 box refrigerated pie dough | 1 egg + 1 teaspoon water (optional egg wash)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; line a baking sheet with parchment. Toss diced apple with cinnamon and brown sugar; set aside. Unroll pie crust on a floured surface. Cut out circles using a 4-inch round cookie cutter. Place 2 teaspoons apple mixture in the center of half the circles. Dab water around edges; top with second circle and press edges to seal. Poke 3–4 vents in the top. Brush with egg wash if desired. Bake 15–18 minutes until golden. Cool 10 minutes before serving.

ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin puree | 1 cup whipped cream cheese (or regular at room temperature) | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons powdered sugar | 2 sleeves graham crackers, crushed (about 2½ cups)
instructions: With an electric mixer, beat pumpkin, cream cheese, pumpkin pie spice, and brown sugar until thoroughly combined, about 2 minutes. In a separate bowl, beat heavy cream and powdered sugar until light and fluffy, about 5 minutes. Layer in 10 mason jars: graham crackers, pumpkin cream cheese mixture, then whipped cream. Repeat layers to fill each jar. Serve chilled.

recipe_name: Egg Bites with Cottage Cheese (and Veggies)
ingredients: 6 large eggs | 1/2 cup whole-milk cottage cheese | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar or mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup finely chopped vegetables (broccoli, spinach, bell pepper, or mushrooms) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F; grease a 12-cup muffin tin very well. Blend eggs and cottage cheese until smooth. Stir in cheese, vegetables, salt, and garlic powder. Pour into muffin cups, filling about 3/4 full. Bake 20–22 minutes until puffed and just set in the center. Let cool 5 minutes; run a knife around edges and remove.

ingredients: 1 15-ounce can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons oil | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas then pat thoroughly dry with a paper towel. Place chickpeas, oil, and salt in a bowl and toss to coat. Place in air fryer basket and air fry at 375°F for 15 minutes or until golden and crispy. Store leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature up to 2 days.

ingredients: 1½ cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup honey or agave nectar | 1 large egg | 2/3 cup milk | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 ripe bananas, mashed | 3/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips plus 1/4 cup for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk honey, egg, milk, oil, and mashed bananas. Slowly combine dry into wet; stir in 3/4 cup chocolate chips. Pour into greased or lined muffin cups, about 2/3 full. Top with remaining chocolate chips. Bake 18 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool and serve.

ingredients: 1½ cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup granulated sugar | 1½ teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 3/4 cup milk | 1/3 cup vegetable or canola oil | 1 large egg, beaten | 1/2 cup chocolate chips or chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; grease or line a 12-cup muffin tin. Sift flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt into a medium bowl. In a large bowl, whisk milk, oil, and egg. Add dry ingredients and stir just until combined. Stir in chocolate chips. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 18–22 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup wheat germ | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 3 medium very ripe bananas, mashed + 1 banana sliced for topping | 1/2 cup agave or honey | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 large egg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Combine flour, wheat germ, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a bowl. In a stand mixer or with a hand mixer, beat 3 bananas, agave, oil, vanilla, and egg until combined. Gently mix in dry ingredients in 3 stages; do not overmix. Grease or line muffin cups; fill 3/4 full. Place banana slices on top. Bake 15 minutes for mini, 20 minutes for regular, until a toothpick comes out clean.

ingredients: 3/4 cup old-fashioned oats | 1½ cups all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1½ teaspoons baking soda | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup honey | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup vegetable or canola oil | 2 large eggs, whisked | 3/4 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix oats, flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt in a bowl. Whisk honey, buttermilk, oil, and eggs in a separate bowl. Pour wet into dry and stir until just combined. Fold in 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Fill 12 greased or lined muffin cups 3/4 full. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips on top. Bake 20–22 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets (fresh or frozen) | 8 ounces stelline pasta (or orzo) | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest (from 1 medium lemon) | 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese | Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add broccoli and cook 4 minutes until tender; transfer to a bowl with a slotted spoon and mince with scissors. Add pasta to the broccoli cooking water; cook per package directions and drain. Return pasta to the pot with the broccoli. Add butter, Parmesan, and lemon zest; stir to combine. Serve topped with extra Parmesan, salt, and pepper as desired.

ingredients: 1 pound chicken breast or tenders, cut into 1–2-inch pieces | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 egg, beaten | 1 cup Italian breadcrumbs or panko | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt | Cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; coat a baking sheet with nonstick spray. Set up three bowls: flour in one, beaten egg in second, breadcrumbs mixed with garlic powder and salt in third. Coat each chicken piece in flour, dip in egg, then coat in breadcrumbs. Place on baking sheet; spray tops with cooking spray. Bake 16–18 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through. Serve with ketchup or dipping sauce.

ingredients: 1 pound ground chicken | 1/2 cup shredded sweet potato | 1/2 cup Italian breadcrumbs | 1 egg | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; line a baking sheet with foil and coat with nonstick spray. Mix all ingredients together with clean hands. Shape into nugget shapes using a tablespoon of mixture per nugget. Place on baking sheet. Bake 18–20 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Serve with ketchup or your favorite dipping sauce.

recipe_name: Peanut Butter and Jelly Pop Tarts
ingredients: 1 box refrigerated pie dough (or homemade) | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup jam or preserves (strawberry, raspberry, or grape) | Water for sealing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Roll pie crust 1/4-inch thick and cut into 2x3-inch rectangles. Place one rectangle on a floured surface; add 1 teaspoon each of peanut butter and preserves in the center. Dab water around the border of the dough. Top with another rectangle and press edges with a fork to seal. Poke a few small holes in the top with a fork or toothpick. Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake 18 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

ingredients: 2 cups cooked spaghetti, cooled | 1/3 cup marinara sauce | 3 large eggs | 1/4 cup capers | 1/2 cup black or green olives, sliced | 1/3 cup Parmesan or mozzarella cheese | Olive oil for sautéing | Extra marinara for dipping
instructions: Cut spaghetti into 1/4–1/2-inch pieces using kitchen scissors. Toss with marinara, eggs, capers, olives, and cheese until completely coated. Heat a thin layer of oil in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Using a 1/4-cup measuring cup, scoop mixture into pan and flatten into 1/2–1-inch disks. Cook 4 minutes per side until golden. Serve with marinara sauce for dipping.

ingredients: 4 cups old-fashioned oats | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup shredded unsweetened coconut | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1 cup chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup vegetable or canola oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Combine oats, flour, coconut, brown sugar, chocolate chips, and salt in a large bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk together oil, vanilla, and honey. Pour wet ingredients over dry and stir thoroughly to combine. Place mixture on a parchment-lined baking sheet and shape into a 13x9x1-inch rectangle. Press firmly so it holds together. Bake 30–40 minutes. Cool completely then cut into 3x1-inch bars.

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup finely shredded carrot | 2 tablespoons vegetable or canola oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Combine flour, Parmesan, baking powder, and salt. Add shredded carrots and toss to coat in flour. Add oil and work dough together with hands until it forms a ball (add 1 extra teaspoon oil if needed). Form into a flat rectangle, rest 1–2 minutes, then roll out 1/2-inch thick on parchment. Cut into 2-inch long by 1/4-inch wide sticks with a sharp knife. Bake on a parchment-lined sheet for 15–17 minutes until golden.

ingredients: 1/2 cup almond butter | 1/2 cup rice syrup | 1 cup Rice Krispies cereal | 1½ cups granola | 1/4 cup dried cranberries, cherries, blueberries, and/or raisins, chopped | Chocolate chips (optional)
instructions: Place almond butter and rice syrup in a small saucepan over low-medium heat. Warm 2 minutes, stirring, until smooth and combined. Combine Rice Krispies, granola, and dried fruit in a bowl. Pour warm almond butter mixture over granola mixture; stir to combine. Stir in chocolate chips if using. Roll into 1-inch balls using a mini ice cream scoop or tablespoon. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

ingredients: 2 cups old-fashioned oats | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 10 tablespoons butter | 1/3 cup chopped almonds (or other nuts) | 1/4 cup honey | 2 cups apple butter or fruit preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place all ingredients except apple butter in a food processor. Pulse until combined and oats and nuts are in small pieces. Press all but 1 cup of mixture into the bottom of a greased 9x9-inch pan lined with parchment. Spread apple butter evenly over the oat layer. Crumble remaining 1 cup oat mixture on top. Bake 30–35 minutes. Cool completely (or refrigerate 1 hour for cleaner cuts), lift out with parchment, and cut into bars.

ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats | 2/3 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup peanut butter or almond butter | 1/2 cup ground flaxseed | 1/2 cup chocolate chips | 1/3 cup honey | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Roll into 1-inch balls. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 week or freeze for up to 3 months.

ingredients: 15-ounce can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 garlic clove | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 2–3 tablespoons ice water | Olive oil and paprika for serving
instructions: Add tahini and lemon juice to a food processor and blend 1 minute until creamy. Add garlic and salt; blend 30 seconds. Add chickpeas and blend 1 minute. With processor running, drizzle in ice water one tablespoon at a time until smooth and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Taste and adjust salt and lemon. Serve drizzled with olive oil and a sprinkle of paprika.

ingredients: 3 pieces soft sandwich bread | Spread of choice (hummus, whipped cream cheese, mayo, mustard) | Filling of choice (tuna salad, deli slices, thinly sliced vegetables, cheese) || FOR TUNA SALAD: 1 can albacore tuna in water | 1 teaspoon capers, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon Dijon mustard | 1 small cucumber cut into thin sticks | 1 small carrot, grated
instructions: Cut crusts off each bread slice and roll out as thin as possible with a rolling pin. Place the long side of the bread closest to you. Spread a thin layer of spread on each slice. Add fillings onto half of the bread lengthwise — don't overstuff. Starting at the filled end, tightly roll up and press to seal (dab a bit of extra spread on the end as glue). Cut into even pieces. If making tuna salad: stir tuna, capers, mayo, and Dijon together in a bowl.

ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 dill pickle, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon fresh dill, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 stalk celery, chopped | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 4 slices sandwich bread
instructions: Combine eggs, pickle, mayonnaise, dill, salt, celery, and lemon juice in a bowl; mix well. Toast bread until golden if desired. Divide egg salad between 2 bread slices and top with remaining slices to make sandwiches. Store egg salad separately from bread in the fridge for up to 3–4 days; assemble just before eating.

ingredients: 1 large flour tortilla or lavash bread | 1/3 cup hummus | 1/2 red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 small carrot, thinly sliced | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh spinach | Purple cabbage, thinly sliced
instructions: Spread hummus evenly over the tortilla or lavash. Place chopped vegetables in rainbow color order (red, orange, yellow, green, purple) towards the middle of the wrap. Leave the edges covered with just hummus so they stick together. Roll up tightly, then slice into coins with a serrated knife.

ingredients: 8 large romaine lettuce leaves | 8 slices turkey deli meat | 8 slices cooked bacon | 1 avocado, sliced
instructions: Remove the stem from each romaine leaf. Lay 1 leaf on a flat surface and place a second leaf on top in the opposite direction to form a sturdy wrap. Layer 2 slices turkey, 2 slices bacon, and 1/4 of the avocado. Roll up into a spiral and cut in half. Secure with a toothpick or lay seam-side down in the lunchbox. Repeat to make 4 wraps.

ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 2 slices whole wheat bread | 4 tablespoons spread of choice (hummus, nut butter, seed butter, or whipped cream cheese) | Toppings of choice
instructions: Using a favorite cookie cutter, press a shape into one piece of whole wheat and one piece of white bread. Cover one whole piece of white bread and one whole piece of wheat bread with your spread and toppings. From the cut-out pieces, swap the white shape into the wheat hole and vice versa, making two-tone tops. Place the two-tone tops onto the filled slices. You will have 2 sandwiches.

ingredients: 4 cups chopped romaine lettuce | 1 cup shredded carrots | 1 cup sliced cucumbers | 1 tomato, chopped | 14.5-ounce can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup cooked chicken, chopped (optional) | 1/2 cup parsley and/or mint leaves, minced (optional) | 4 burrito-size tortillas | 1/2 cup prepared hummus | 1/4 cup lemon juice | Salt and pepper
instructions: Add lettuce, carrots, cucumbers, tomato, chickpeas, feta, chicken (if using), herbs (if using), hummus, and lemon juice to a large bowl. Toss gently to combine. Season with salt and pepper. Add 2 cups salad to center of each tortilla. Fold in sides, fold over one end, then roll up tightly. Serve immediately or wrap in foil and refrigerate up to 3 days.

ingredients: 4 flour or corn tortillas (soft variety) | 1/2 cup pumpkin puree (or sweet potato or butternut squash puree) | 1 can (15 ounces) black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup shredded cheese (cheddar or Mexican blend) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | Salsa, sour cream, or guacamole for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; line a sheet pan with parchment. Lay tortillas flat on the pan. Spread 1 tablespoon puree on half of each tortilla. Top with 1/4 cup beans, 1/4 cup cheese, and a pinch of cumin. Bake 8–10 minutes until cheese is melted. Fold tortillas over and press down; return to oven 2–3 minutes more. Cut into triangles with kitchen scissors and serve with salsa, sour cream, or guacamole.

ingredients: 2 flour or corn tortillas (soft variety) | 1/2 cup mashed sweet potato | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | Neutral oil or butter for the pan | Salsa or sour cream for serving
instructions: Spread mashed sweet potato over one half of each tortilla. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and a pinch of cumin. Fold each tortilla over into a half-moon shape. Heat a cast iron skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. Cook quesadillas 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cheese is melted. Cut into triangles or strips with kitchen scissors and serve with salsa or sour cream.

ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1/2 cup minced celery | 1/2 cup minced carrot | 1/2 cup minced onion | 4 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1 cup stelline or orzo pasta | 16 mini meatballs (store-bought frozen or homemade) | 1/2 cup marinara sauce (optional) | Parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add garlic, celery, carrot, and onion; cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add broth and bring to a boil. Add pasta and cook per package directions. Add meatballs and cook until warmed through, about 5 minutes. Stir in marinara sauce if using. Season with salt, pepper, and Parmesan. Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers up to 5 days.

ingredients: 1 pound ground turkey | 1/2 cup shredded zucchini, squeezed very dry | 1/2 cup Italian-flavored breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese | 1 egg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment. Mix all ingredients together with clean hands in a medium bowl. Form into 2-tablespoon-size balls and place on the baking sheet. Bake 22–24 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. (Air fryer: 12 minutes at 375°F.) Serve with marinara, pesto, or cheese sauce.

ingredients: 1/2 pound mild Italian sausage | 1 pound ground beef | 1/3 cup grated Parmesan | 1/3 cup Italian-flavored breadcrumbs | 1 egg | 24-ounce jar marinara sauce (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; grease a rimmed baking sheet. Remove sausage from casings if needed. Mix sausage, beef, Parmesan, breadcrumbs, and egg with clean hands until thoroughly combined. Portion into 2-inch balls and place on baking sheet. Bake 22–25 minutes. Drain on a paper towel-lined plate. Serve plain or simmer in marinara sauce and serve with pasta or in rolls.

ingredients: 1/4 cup diced onion | 1/4 cup diced carrot | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves | 1 pound ground lamb | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 egg | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese | 1/4 cup raisins or diced dried apricots | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/3 cup plain breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and coat with nonstick spray. Place onion, carrot, and parsley in a food processor; grind finely 30 seconds. Add lamb, cumin, egg, cheese, raisins, salt, and breadcrumbs; process 30–60 seconds until combined. Form into 1-inch balls and place on baking sheet. Bake 18–20 minutes until just starting to brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve with cucumber sauce or in tomato sauce with pasta.

ingredients: 1 pound farfalle or rotini pasta | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 medium English cucumber, sliced into half-moons | 1 cup diced mozzarella | 1/2 cup thinly sliced red onion (optional) || DRESSING: 3/4 cup olive oil | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | Freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Cook pasta per package directions in salted water; drain. Let cool while you prep the vegetables. Shake dressing ingredients together in a jar or whisk in a bowl. Add all ingredients to a large bowl and mix gently to combine. Serve cold or at room temperature. Store in airtight container in fridge up to 5 days.

ingredients: 8 ounces pasta | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 8 ounces cooked chicken, shredded or diced | 6 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 1 cup croutons | 1/4–1/2 cup Caesar dressing | 1/4 cup shredded Parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook pasta per package directions; drain and toss with olive oil to prevent sticking as it cools. When cool, add pasta to a large bowl with chicken, lettuce, croutons, Caesar dressing, and Parmesan. Toss gently to combine. Serve immediately or pack in lunchboxes — store up to 2 days in the fridge.

ingredients: 1/4 cup each minced carrots, parsley, and onion | 1 pound ground beef | 1/2 cup Italian-flavored breadcrumbs | 1 egg | 1/4 cup grated Parmesan | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; line a baking sheet with foil and spray with nonstick spray. Place carrots, parsley, and onion in a food processor; grind until uniform. Add beef, breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, and salt; combine well. Form into 1.5-tablespoon balls and place on baking sheet. Bake 22–25 minutes or until cooked through. Serve with marinara sauce and pasta or ketchup.

ingredients: 1 burrito-size whole grain flour tortilla | 1–2 tablespoons condiment or spread (mayo, mustard, guacamole, mashed avocado, cream cheese, hummus, or peanut butter) | 2–3 ounces protein filling (turkey, ham, chicken salad, tuna salad, bacon, or cheese) | 1/4 cup produce (shredded lettuce, baby spinach, sliced bell pepper, shredded carrot, or cucumber) | Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place wrap on a cutting board. Warm 5–10 seconds in microwave if needed so it's pliable. Spread condiment to within 1/2 inch of edges. Add protein down the center. Top with produce. Put a little extra spread or sticky ingredient on the edges to help it hold together. Roll up tightly and slice with a serrated knife. Serve immediately or wrap in foil and refrigerate up to 24 hours.
